parts.text: $PSCO Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +5% Y/Y, supported by lower total costs and an operating margin of 28.1%. #earnings #utilities
$ALNY Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +17% Y/Y, driven by AMVUTTRA sales. Operating margin 23.7%; net earnings $2.2B supported by tax items. Operating cash flow reached $341M. #earnings #pharma
$BC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +7% Y/Y, driven by steady OEM demand with sales growth across all segments for the fifth consecutive quarter. Operating margin 5.4%. #earnings #industrials

$ATI Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +26% Y/Y, driven by strong demand and pricing in aerospace and defense markets, particularly commercial jet engine products. Operating margin 19.1%; net earnings $193M. #earnings #materials
$RMD Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $1.4B, +6% Y/Y, driven by global demand for sleep and breathing health solutions. Operating margin 32.0%; net earnings $418M. #earnings #medtech
$ALHC Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +37% Y/Y, driven by continued growth in health plan membership. Operating margin was -0.3% as total costs rose alongside revenue. #earnings #insurance
$DXCM Q3 2026: revenue $1.3B, +11% Y/Y, driven by continued adoption of continuous glucose monitoring systems. Operating margin 24.3%; operating cash flow $326M. #earnings #medtech
$PTEN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.3B, +14% Y/Y, supported by increased U.S. onshore drilling and completion demand. Operating margin 4.7%; operating cash flow $301M. #earnings #oil
$GDDY Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.3B, +6% Y/Y, driven by Applications and Commerce expansion and growing Airo adoption. Operating margin 27.0%. #earnings #tech

$GHC Q3 2026: revenue $1.3B, +4% Y/Y, driven by higher revenue at television broadcasting, healthcare, and manufacturing, while education declined. Operating margin 6.4%; operating cash flow $160M. #earnings #industrials

$AXTA Q3 2026: revenue $1.3B, +2% Y/Y, driven by growth in Mobility Coatings while overall costs rose faster than sales. Operating margin was 12.6% amid broader economic pressures on expenses. #earnings #materials
$AB Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, +8% Y/Y, driven by higher performance-based and advisory base fees. Operating margin was 20.1% as employee compensation and general costs increased. #earnings #finance
